market.summary: Profit booking after a sharp November rally: Nifty fell 0.63% to 25,228 and midcaps fell more (-1.2%), with about two stocks falling for every one rising. Metals, consumer durables, IT and autos led the fall. Brent eased to about $92, which helps India, and foreign inflows for November are reported near a record $10 billion. For your trades this is a broad pullback, not company news: four of six holdings fell with the market; only Leela rose.

points.text: Sensex closed at 82,031.81 (-500 points, -0.61%) and Nifty at 25,227.95 (-0.63%), ending a two-day rise; Nifty Midcap 100 fell 1.22%.
On BSE, 2,800 stocks fell and 1,448 rose; 13 of 16 sector indices ended lower, with Metal -2.5% and Consumer Durables about -3% (Titan -5.3%).
Nifty IT fell 1.24%; Pharma, Media and PSU banks were small gainers. BSE Ltd, a capital-market stock like Groww, fell 2.8%.
Brent crude was about $92 (down about 1%); MCX gold fell 2.3% and silver 3.5% on a stronger US dollar.
Foreign portfolio inflows are reported at around $10 billion so far in November, a record.

market.watch: Whether the pullback stays shallow (midcaps -1.2% today); the US dollar and yields, which weighed on metals and gold.

GROWW.summary: No new filing or company news today. Groww eased 1.8% to ₹223.52 on a weak day for capital-market stocks (BSE Ltd -2.8%) but stayed above its 10 EMA (₹219.83) and the ₹219 block-deal price. NSE's deal report shows the 17 Nov block was taken by long-term funds, including several BlackRock funds; the stock shows accumulation (5 buying days to 2 selling days in 25 sessions). The trade is at about +1.9R with the stop at cost.

points.text: 17 Nov block deals at ₹219: BlackRock Emerging Markets Fund bought about 53.6 lakh shares, BlackRock Global Funds EM Fund about 24 lakh, BlackRock India Fund about 17 lakh; BNP Paribas Arbitrage bought 36.5 lakh.
Capital-market stocks were weak: BSE Ltd fell 2.83% today.

GROWW.watch: A close below ₹219.83 (10 EMA, also near the ₹219 block price) sells half; below ₹212.22 (20 EMA) the rest.
